verdict.rationale: Gusto's API supports pagination for retrieving large lists (docs-7,35,43,50) and contractor_payment_groups let you preview/process multiple contractor payments together (docs-27), which is a partial nod to batch-style operations. However there is no documented bulk-write endpoint for mass-updating employees, running payroll across many companies, or any explicit batch API for arbitrary bulk operations. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch write endpoints (e.g., bulk employee updates, multi-company payroll runs), documented rate/size limits for batch jobs, and any hands-on evidence of large-scale bulk automation succeeding.
